## Task-2

```{r}
count_above<-function(x,number){
  count <- 0

for ( i in 1:length(x)){
  if (x[i] > number) {
    count <- count+1
  }
}
  return(count)
}
count_above(6,3)
```

## Task-3

Masking functions is when you hide your inputs and make the final rendered document only show outputs. For example for the print functions I have above, the viewer would only see the results instead of the code and results.
